impact: No Authenticator GPS or approving-device telemetry; accidental approval is confirmed through business verification, not device telemetry.
No access token, refresh token, cookie, Authorization header, MFA seed or secret is present.
Applied policy results and controls are present; internal condition evaluation traces are not modeled.
IPs and locations are synthetic; location analysis tests logic rather than third-party GeoIP accuracy.
The scenario does not model B2B, service-provider or passthrough sign-ins.
Risk fields emulate P2-equivalent visibility; actual tenants may return hidden or delayed values.
Field semantics follow official schemas, but the files are not byte-for-byte portal or Graph exports.
